text.label: Heading: I have run a podcast since 2008. Here is what it does for yo
text.value: I have run a podcast since 2008. Here is what it does for you.

text.label: Text: I started recording these conversations in 2008, long before
text.value: I started recording these conversations in 2008, long before a podcast was something everybody had. I was not trying to be a radio host. I had been running businesses for years by then, and I had learned that the fastest way to get better at anything is to sit down with somebody who has already done it and ask them how. A podcast gave me a reason to ask. Some of those conversations are further down this page, still here for anybody to watch.

text.label: Text: A short clip gets you noticed. It does not get you paid. Alm
text.value: A short clip gets you noticed. It does not get you paid. Almost nobody buys the first time they hear from you. They need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times before they trust you enough to hand over real money. A long conversation covers a lot of that ground in one sitting. The listener hears how you think, how you talk, and whether you actually know your subject. By the end they feel like they know you. Nothing short does that.

text.label: Text: When you sit across from somebody who wrote the book or buil
text.value: When you sit across from somebody who wrote the book or built the company, some of their credibility lands on you. The listener sees you asking good questions of a person they already respect, and they put you in the same room in their head. There is a second benefit. When a guest shares the episode with their own audience, you are in front of people who had never heard your name, introduced by somebody they already trust.

text.label: Text: One conversation does not stay one conversation. It becomes
text.value: One conversation does not stay one conversation. It becomes the full episode, and then it gets cut into short clips for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Every one of those clips points back to your website. That is system two of the Revenue Engine, the Automated Organic Content Engine, and the podcast is what feeds it. You stop staring at your phone wondering what to say today. You already said it, on the record, with somebody interesting sitting across from you.

text.label: Text: It lives on your land.
Text: The episodes sit on a website you own. That matters more tha
text.value: The episodes sit on a website you own. That matters more than most people realize. A social platform can change its rules or shut your account off tomorrow, and everything you built there goes with it. A clip is gone from the feed fast. An episode on your own website does not expire. Somebody can find it years from now and it still does its job. You are looking at the proof. The interviews on this page were recorded a long time ago and they are still working for me.

text.label: Text: It costs next to nothing.
Text: This used to take a radio station, a studio and a payroll, a
text.value: This used to take a radio station, a studio and a payroll, and somebody at the door deciding who got on the air. Most people could not even get into that space. That has been flipped on its head. The platforms that carry a podcast today are free to use. Anybody can be heard. What it costs now is the technical work of setting it up and the discipline of keeping it going, and that is exactly where most people quit. That is the part my team and I take off your plate.

text.label: Text: A modern day talent agency.
Text: When somebody asks me what I do for a living, that is the an
text.value: When somebody asks me what I do for a living, that is the answer. My team and I are a modern day talent agency. A talent agent used to be the person who got you on radio and TV. Today nobody has to let you in, so the job changed. We teach you self-promotion, we package what you know into something a person can buy, and we show you how to sell it with a modern website and the sales system behind it. That sales system is the Revenue Engine. Whatever you do for a living, you need self-promotion to make it work, and your own podcast is where it starts.

text.value: Every episode is below. Watch the interview, then go get their book or their tool. Notice how each one is laid out: the conversation, the person, and the thing they sell, side by side on a website I own. That is on purpose. We produce a podcast like this one for every client, on their own website, and right after the episodes I walk you through how it works, piece by piece.

Are your plans sufficient to keep your children with people you know and trust during those critical hours? And what about your money and your home? Will your legal documents keep your family together, or tear them apart?

It teaches you to take charge of your own financial future, and it can change the financial life of your children and grandchildren too.

text.label: Text: If every person could get out of debt, save…

There would be a snowball effect that would change this country: more savings, which creates more jobs; less government spending on taking care of people, which means lower taxes, which means more money in your pocket.

text.label: Heading: My team and I produce a podcast like this for you, on your o
text.value: My team and I produce a podcast like this for you, on your own website.

text.label: Text: Every client we work with gets their own show. It carries yo
text.value: Every client we work with gets their own show. It carries your name, it lives on your website, and it is laid out just like the page you are reading now. This is not a guest spot on my podcast. It is yours. It comes with the build in both ways of working with us, right alongside your own e-book with your name on the cover. You are getting a copy of my business, front to back, and the podcast is one of the pieces that makes it work.

text.label: Text: Plenty of coaches, authors and influencers have thought abou
text.value: Plenty of coaches, authors and influencers have thought about a podcast. Many never record one, and many who do stop after a few episodes. It is rarely because they have nothing to say. It is the work around the talking. Setting it up. Cleaning up the recording. Cutting it down. Getting it onto a website. Getting clips out everywhere. It piles up, they fall behind, and the show dies quietly. That is a labor problem, not a talent problem. You bring the talent. Handling everything around it is what a talent agency is for.

text.label: Text: You show up and you talk. That is your whole job. You choose
text.value: You show up and you talk. That is your whole job. You choose the people you want to sit down with and the subjects you want to cover, because what you know is yours and nobody else can say it for you. Then you have the conversation. You do not edit anything. You do not learn a new program. You do not figure out where the recording goes when you are done. If you can hold a good conversation over coffee, you can do this.

text.label: Text: Everything else. My team and I set the show up from scratch
text.value: Everything else. My team and I set the show up from scratch and build its home on your website. After you record, we clean up the conversation and turn it into a finished episode. We cut it into short clips and put them out on every platform you show up on, each one pointing back to your website. Every episode gets its own spot on your page, with your product sitting right beside it. AI employees do the heavy lifting, my team checks the work, and I am personally on your account.

text.label: Text: Once it is running, your week gets simpler, not busier. You
text.value: Once it is running, your week gets simpler, not busier. You sit down and record a conversation. Then you go back to coaching, writing, or whatever it is you are actually good at. The episodes and clips keep showing up in front of your audience on the days you do nothing at all. You are no longer the person who has to remember to put something out. Your followers hear from you again and again, and you only had to say it once.

text.label: Text: A podcast with nothing behind it is a hobby. Ours is the fro
text.value: A podcast with nothing behind it is a hobby. Ours is the front end of the Revenue Engine. The episode and its clips bring people to your website. Your e-book is for sale there. When somebody raises a hand, Speed to Lead answers them in seconds, day or night. Your reviews show them proof from people you have already helped. Database Reactivation goes back to the ones who went quiet. That is how a listener becomes a paying client instead of one more follower.

text.label: Text: If having your own podcast and your own product scares you,
text.value: If having your own podcast and your own product scares you, we are not the right fit. I would rather tell you that now than after you apply. You do not have to be polished. You do not need a radio voice. The honest episodes are always the best ones. But you do have to be willing to sit down, be heard, and put your name on what you know. If that sounds like you, the book and the guest form below are the next steps if you want to learn more or come on the show.
